notes.title: Bayan is Here! New Crew Member Updated.
notes.notes:
Dear CMDRs,
We are thrilled to announce an exciting new game update that will enhance your gaming experience. Here are the highlights of the update:
New Character - Bayan: We're introducing a new character, Bayan, from the Apple Homeland. You can meet her in the first level of the BOSS mode, and upon successful completion, you will unlock her. Her unique skills and backstory will add depth to the game.
Three New Primary Weapons: We've added three new primary weapon choices to help you better face the challenges posed by your enemies. Each weapon has its own unique characteristics, adding more variety to your adventures.

Balance Adjustments: In pursuit of a fair gaming experience, we've made several balance adjustments to ensure that all weapons and characters have their own value in battle. This will make the game more challenging and enjoyable.

Enhanced Game Pad Support: We're continually improving the interactive of game pad .

We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback. This update has been made possible by your enthusiasm. We hope you enjoy these new additions and continue to have fun playing the game.

Thank you for being a part of Rabat Crew！

Best regards,
What's Up Game Labs

notes.title: Boss Mode Update!
notes.notes:
Hello CMDRs

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of our brand-new BOSS Mode! Currently, BOSS Mode has only one level, but we will be adding and expanding more exciting content in the future! In this mode, you will face a series of formidable bosses, taking turns to engage in intense battles. Do you have the courage to take on this challenge?

This update brings more excitement and strategy to the game. Each boss comes with unique attack patterns and weaknesses, and you'll need to identify and employ the best strategies to defeat them.

Come and try out this thrilling new mode, test your shooting skills, and reap handsome rewards! We appreciate your continued support, so let's fight together!

notes.title: In light of the earthquake in Morocco on September 9th
notes.notes:
Today is a sorrowful one.

We admire the regional culture of Morocco very much, as well as the fantasy of World War II, so we called the game Rabat Protocol.

Our production team expresses our most sincere condolences to the Moroccan people affected by the earthquake.

We hope for a swift relief of the situation.

Sincerely,
Rabat Protocol Development Team

notes.title: Storm at New Wild Airport
notes.notes:
In North Africa's New Wild Airport, a sandstorm rages as an aerial operation unfolds. The ground crew works fast to ready the Spitfire fighters and Mosquito bombers for the battle ahead. This mission targets iron-skin moles that have infiltrated underground water sources, disrupting local ecology—all connected to the mysterious Sky Dominator Adonis.

In a quiet corner of the airport, guerrilla fighters take a break, sipping British-style tea while maintaining their weapons, momentarily forgetting the imminent battle. As night falls, the Spitfires and Mosquitoes take off, heading for their target. Meanwhile, Sky Dominator Adonis's airships silently approach.

As they near the mission area, ground radar detects the airships. This mysterious enemy has formidable combat power, posing a significant threat. The commander orders the Spitfires to engage the enemy in a surprise attack, while the Mosquitoes continue towards their target.

During the fierce battle, the Spitfires utilize their agility to target the airships' weak points, while the airships retaliate with overwhelming firepower. On the ground, guerrilla fighters join the battle, driving jeeps and operating various weapons against Sky Dominator Adonis's airships.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534732/80b124f0d263f59e814115e2e6c519f4d59ef89e.png[/img]
After a thrilling fight, our guerrilla fighters seize an opportunity and destroy the power system of the airships, which lose control and crash into the desert. The iron-skin moles are defeated by the Mosquitoes' bombardment, restoring the local ecology.

The Spitfires and Mosquitoes return to New Wild Airport, where the ground crew applauds their victory. The exhausted fighters gather in the cafeteria, savoring British tea and celebrating their win.

However, the battle's end doesn't mean Sky Dominator Adonis's influence is gone. Their impact still lurks in the world, awaiting new opportunities. To defend peace and justice, the heroes know they must stay vigilant and be prepared for future challenges.

In this desert land, the aerial storm may have passed, but the brave fighters will keep moving forward for a brighter future. The jeeps, Spitfires, and Mosquitoes that accompanied them will remain their eternal comrades, witnessing every glorious moment.

notes.title: New Wild Airport Sneak Preview Unveiled
notes.notes:
Dear CMDRs: 
We are thrilled to bring you an exciting piece of news!We are about to present you with the Stage 3 in Survival Mode: New Wild Airport! This new scenario will bring unprecedented challenges to your guerrilla team members, as enemies descend from the sky, making the gaming experience more intense and thrilling!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534732/192b77da993898dd547ee3e4a141605773ed9fbe.png[/img]

1.New Scenario: New Wild Airport
In this new scenario, your guerrilla team members will no longer face threats solely from ground enemies. Aerial adversaries will swoop down from the skies, exponentially increasing the pressure of battle. How will you lead your guerrilla team to confront these aerial challenges and successfully fend off enemy attacks?

2.New Enemies: Armored Zeppelin, Iron Wolf (Focke-Wulf Ausf. D), SD.Kfz 251 Armored Personnel Carrier
In this brand-new level, you will face three formidable new enemies. The Armored Zeppelin will rain down artillery shells from the sky, causing devastating damage to your guerrilla team members; the Iron Wolf (Focke-Wulf Ausf. D), a swift and lethal fighter aircraft, will display its fearsome firepower in the air; and the SD.Kfz 251 Armored Personnel Carrier will rapidly deliver ground troops to the battlefield, intensifying the pressure on your guerrilla team members.

3.Tactical Strategies: How to Deal with Aerial Enemies?
When faced with aerial challenges, you will need to rethink your tactical strategies. Skillful use of terrain, buildings, and anti-aircraft weapons will be the key to victory in this new scenario. You must combat aerial enemies while also protecting your guerrilla team members, ensuring their safe completion of tasks.

In summary,the Stage 3 in Survival Mode, New Wild Airport, will bring you a brand-new gaming experience, Stay tuned for our follow-up updates!

notes.title: Roguelite Fantasy WWII CABAL-Style Game, Anyone? Rabat Protocol Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
    we are a group of player developers who love to develop fantasy WWII games.

Today we are proud to release our  game, a highly challenging CABAL-style shooter where CMDR(players) must survive in extreme battlefield conditions.

In the game, players will take on the roles of two special agents who investigate strange phenomena on the North African front, riding in a heavily modified Willys off-road vehicle.

They will need to use all means necessary to survive, including tactical coordination, weapon selection, and battlefield skills.

The survival mode will test your understanding of weapons, including the Sten, Bren, Bazooka, Winchester shotgun, 2-inch grenade launcher, Colt M1911, M1931 pillbox heavy machine gun, Mills grenade, Lee-Enfield rifle, and more. Each weapon has its own features, advantages and disadvantages, and upgrade paths.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534732/d4f7440846abe2574dfcb0a493c573d138920af4.jpg[/img]



Friendly support includes Sherman tanks, various infantry units, flame fighters, Mosquito fighters, B-17 bombers, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43534732/a0999050adcfd89f6f0f876fdad72f486ae82c5c.jpg[/img]

Buy now on Steam and experience this adrenaline-fueled shooting game!

The game is currently in Early Access, and we will release more content based on community feedback in the future!

Please send any bug reports to tech@wansoyo.com.
